answer_1.quote: LLMs have achieved significant success in debating tasks, including argument quality assessment and debate process simulation

answer_2.quote: we propose InspireScore, a novel evaluation system that integrates both subjective and objective dimensions to enable comprehensive debate assessment

answer_3.quote: we employ a structured, prompt-based assessment across key dimensions, namely, emotional appeal, argument clarity, argument arrangement, and topic relevance

answer_4.quote: Three human annotators, each holding a master's degree and possessing debate experience, rate both sides of each debate across six subjective and objective dimensions
answer_4.guideline: evaluate the performance of each side of the debate based on six specific dimensions: Emotional Appeal, Argument Clarity, Argument Arrangement, Topic Relevance, Logical Validity, Fact Authenticity
